# Relay security and data

Conversation data is retained for 24 months by default. On the Team plan an admin can shorten the retention period to 30 days, and deleted conversations are removed from backups within 35 days.

All customer data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Customers choose between EU and US data residency when they create the workspace.

Our SOC 2 Type II report is available under NDA. We run an external penetration test once a year and share the summary on request.

SCIM user provisioning works with Okta and Microsoft Entra on the Team plan.
